patterns.note: Alternating two-column layout for feature sections, where an image occupies one column and descriptive text with a call-to-action occupies the other, switching sides for visual rhythm.
Prominent, elegant serif typeface for main section headings, creating a strong visual hierarchy and sophisticated brand character, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text.
A muted, earthy green-grey is used as a primary accent color for the hero overlay and call-to-action buttons, providing a calm and established feel against a white background.
Major content sections (e.g., 'About Haus', 'Building Dreams') reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they scroll into the viewport.
Section titles are consistently centered and underlined with a short, dark grey line, providing a clear and understated visual break between content blocks.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background image with a semi-transparent, solid color overlay box positioned over a portion of the image, containing the primary message and call-to-action.

Content sections are designed to animate into view as the user scrolls, utilizing CSS keyframe animations to apply a subtle fade-in and a slight upward translation effect to elements when they enter the visible viewport, likely triggered by JavaScript scroll detection.
Call-to-action buttons use a solid background color with contrasting white text and sharp corners, maintaining a consistent visual style across the site.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, decorative serif headings (~3x body) provide strong visual anchors, while body text is a legible sans-serif; hero text is a medium sans-serif for clarity.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all elements, including buttons and image frames, maintain crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — sections are well-separated with ample vertical padding, while content within sections maintains a comfortable, readable density.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with a sophisticated blend of a strong, elegant serif display font for headings and a muted, earthy color palette. The unique hero section, featuring a partial, solid-color overlay box for text, creates a distinctive and refined first impression that avoids generic full-width text overlays.
